decisions.reason: The authoritative script changes the exact spoken wording, but the separate staging requirement to begin by stating that someone sent a message and reading it from the phone remains valid unchanged.
The gameplay sequence was already established from message 23, and the exact-adherence instruction does not add, remove, or reorder any of its demonstration steps.

It is unclear whether saying the message-23 script exactly as written requires literal English wording or exact content translated into Igbo; changing the spoken-language requirement would require clarification.
The exact-script instruction may prioritize complete narration over the reported 50–60-second duration, but it does not explicitly cancel or revise that duration constraint.
